ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio; the surface area is predominantly composed of low-intensity pixels (black) with high-intensity pixels limited to localized distal clusters and edge highlights.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 18-22 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; denticle peaks exhibit a pixel amplitude of 5-15 units, distributed continuously along the entire trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply pointed, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, high-contrast pixel clusters (white) concentrated on the distal wingtips and along the outer leading edges; secondary low-contrast circular ring constellations visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on both distal tips and portions of the leading edge, creating irregular, high-relief protrusions from the fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical aspect of the fluke tips relative to the horizontal plane of the median notch.
